title: Decisions log
summary: Agent-maintained log of 112 numbered technical decisions (D-001 to D-112) with per-entry status, covering engine, tooling, level generation, gameplay and audio.
notes: Multi-decision log, not a single ADR. Entries use ADR-style Context/Decision/Consequences/Status sections, so ADR is the closest type. File-level locked is false because the file itself has no Accepted status; each entry carries its own status. Observed statuses: 110 entries Accepted (D-040 'Accepted (partly supersedes D-013)', D-091 'Accepted (reviewer approved the spec, 2026-10-26)', D-092 'Accepted' etc.), D-104 'Reverted', no Rejected or Superseded-by entries found. Synthesizer should extract per-entry status rather than treat the whole file as locked. Source file is 1243 lines; only entry titles and status lines were scanned (Grep), not every entry body. Output filename lacks the required source_hash suffix because no hashing tool was available to this classifier (Bash not in toolset); orchestrator must rename to DECISIONS-<sha256(/home/renaud/pewet/specs/DECISIONS.md)[0:8]>.json.
